comparisons.peer_summary: All Other operating loss was $4.2 billion in 2024 and $4.4 billion in 2023, primarily consisting of amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and stock-based compensation expense.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD disclose stock-based compensation expense as a significant driver of operating results. AVGO reports a total stock-based compensation expense of $5,670 million, driven by VMware merger awards and higher grant-date fair values. AMD reports $1.4 billion of stock-based compensation expense, but it is embedded within a larger 'All Other' operating loss category that also includes significant amortization of acquisition-related intangibles ($2.4 billion in 2024). While both firms face increasing SBC expenses, AVGO isolates SBC as a primary growth item in its results, whereas AMD's SBC is presented as a component of a broader non-core operating loss line item dominated by intangible amortization.
